module: Auxiliary transbrake controller (drag racing gearbox brake): it locks the gearbox via `gearbox:setLock(value)`. The lock is active when `gearbox.lockCoef == 0`. Publishes this state in `electrics.values[electricsName]` and adds an entry to the radial menu. Can also be commanded by the gameplay event `controller:<name>`.
usage:
controller.getControllerSafe("transbrake").setTransbrake(true)
-- or, on the game side:
-- onGameplayEvent("controller:transbrake", {"setTransbrake", true})
notes: `M.updateGFX` is declared as `nop` at the bottom of the file but init replaces it with the real function if the gearbox exists (otherwise it stays `nop`).
onGameplayEvent hook: the event must be "controller:<typeName or name>" and `eventData` a table {"setTransbrake", boolean}; an incorrect type is logged as an error.
This controller is relocated: the old name `transbrake` is redirected to `braking/transbrake`.

updateGFX.desc: nop by default, replaced in init by the function that publishes the electrics when the gearbox exists.

getState.desc: Returns whether the transbrake is active.

init.desc: Finds the gearbox, chooses the updateGFX function and adds the radial menu entry (only once).

onGameplayEvent.desc: Hook from controller.lua. If the event name is "controller:<typeName>" or "controller:<name>", runs the command contained in eventData: {"setTransbrake", boolean}. Example: onGameplayEvent("controller:transbrake", {"setTransbrake", true}).

setState.desc: Enables or disables the transbrake to match the saved state (silently).

setTransbrake.desc: Applies or releases the gearbox lock (`gearbox:setLock`) and displays a message unless silent.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.
